name: Mythal Touched

source.note: Compared with the published D&D Beyond chapter on 2026-10-06: https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/frhof/character-options.

summary: Reference-only: Reaction when hit by a spell attack or failing a spell save: roll on the Mythal-Touched Magic table in the source. DC 8 + modifier of the increased ability + PB; PB uses per Long Rest. Table effects require manual resolution.
